tools.name: get_price_book
tools.description: Get the business's price book (optionally for one trade: aircon, roofing, electrical): items with unit, low/high price ex tax, required questions, minimum charge and whether a site visit is required.

tools.name: calculate_quote
tools.description: Deterministically price selected items: per-line low/high, minimum charges, subtotal, tax (GST/USt) and total ranges. Reports unanswered questions and whether a site visit is required. Returns quote_id.

answers.description: Answers to the item's required questions

tools.name: create_quote_document
tools.description: Create a PDF-ready JSON quote document. doc_type estimate (any market, price ranges) or angebot (Germany: binding offer, fixed prices only, mandatory fields validated: Angebotsnummer, Datum, Gueltig bis, Anbieter with Steuernummer/USt-IdNr, Kunde, Positionen, Netto, USt, Brutto, Zahlungsbedingungen).

tools.name: book_site_visit
tools.description: Book a site visit for a confirmed slot, linked to the quote.

tools.name: transfer_to_human
tools.description: Hand the conversation to the business owner or estimator (complex job, commercial work, safety issue, customer request).
